transport: RS-485 over DB9 female · Modbus RTU · baud rate NOT stated in the vendor manual · slave ID 4 per one community configuration only, unconfirmed. DB9 pinout from docs (vendor manual, UPower-Hi V2.1): pins 1-4 = NC, 5 = GND, 6 = NC, 7 = RS-485-A, 8 = RS-485-B, 9 = +5 VDC. An 8-pin RJ45 pinout (1/2 = 5 VDC, 3/4 = B, 5/6 = A, 7/8 = GND) also appears in the same manual for the BMS-Link side.
blocks: Community reports place real-time data in the 0x3500 range and settings at 0x9607+, with a discrete input at 0x2100. No block boundaries are documented. Treat every address as unverified.
gotchas: THIS IS A SEPARATE DIALECT FROM epever-upower AND THAT IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THE ENTRY. Both live in the 0x3500 range, which invites exactly the wrong assumption. The community source's own attribution is thin and the author says so: the register values were derived "from perl script (which I have found from German FHEM forum)". No vendor document, no second independent implementation located. community-single, and the tag is doing real work here.

Slave ID 4 comes from one Home Assistant configuration. Note that it is neither the controller's 1 nor the IPower's 3 nor anything stated by EPEver — plausible as a per-line convention, entirely unverified.
